digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action / bridge-state persistence
propositions: The Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action and Reconciler Heartbeat Canary fail on every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z with ACLI error 'value leg does not exist for field project' when executing JQL query 'project = LEG AND status != Done'

The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO that do not exist in live REB Jira, causing the multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot to issue syntactically-valid but Jira-rejected queries
The corruption was introduced via ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e) on the live tickets branch 21 minutes before the first failure, authored with test-fixture git identity
The known-good state is projects.json with empty projects dict and legacy_default='REB', which causes the fan-out to default to single-project mode and skip the nonexistent keys
The projects_store write path bypasses the shared write lock and does not auto-commit or auto-push, enabling the ad-hoc hand-commits that corrupted live state
